table_title: In what year did each current EU member state join the European Union?
db_analog: SELECT country, accession_year FROM eu_member_states WHERE membership_status = 'current' ORDER BY accession_year, country
temporal_note: Wikidata SPARQL endpoint snapshot, accessed 2026-04-27. Universe is the 27 current EU member states — countries with a `P463=Q458` (member of: European Union) statement and no `P582` end-time qualifier on that statement. Excludes the United Kingdom (P582 = 2020-01-31 post-Brexit). Membership year is the `P580` start-time qualifier on the P463 statement; values are stable historical facts and will only change as new countries accede or leave.
_extraction_notes: Built via datasets/build_benchmark/sparql_to_csv.py running the SPARQL at datasets/build_benchmark/sparql_queries/eu_member_states_accession_years.sparql. The query uses the statement-node form (p:P463/ps:P463 with pq:P580 and pq:P582) because reading qualifiers (start time, end time) requires the full statement node — the truthy `wdt:P463` shortcut cannot expose qualifiers. Per `references/sparql-gotchas.md` §1 Option B, deprecated-rank statements are explicitly excluded via `FILTER NOT EXISTS wikibase:rank wikibase:DeprecatedRank`. The `FILTER NOT EXISTS pq:P582` clause is the universe filter for current members; Brexit-excluded UK has P582 = 2020-01-31 and is correctly omitted. Result: 27 rows × 2 columns, 0 duplicate primary keys. PK on Country alone is sufficient because each current member has exactly one P463=Q458 statement with a start-time qualifier.
